biology: The specimens were obtained from the tree Schima superba.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is nearly rectangular, the head width index 0.71–0.73, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the top of the frons rounded. The labrum is lingulate, the semi-transparent apical region narrow and rounded, both the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs extremely fine, the dorsal labral hairs coarse and long. The mandibles are stout, the apices rather straight, the curved part quite short; the mandibular length about 0.68 times the head capsule length and 0.96 times the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies slightly in front of the anterior one-third of the head, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region broad and short with the sides nearly parallel, the waist constriction index about 0.43. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, about 1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, the median notch rather deep, the anterior and posterior lateral corners evenly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with more than thirty hairs in the middle region.
